legal.termsText:
TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF USE AND CONTRACTING OF THE RESPI PLATFORM

Last updated: June 2026

1. PURPOSE AND SCOPE
These Terms of Use and Contracting (hereinafter, the "Terms") govern access, navigation and use of the RESPI mobile application and backend platform (hereinafter, the "Application" or the "System"). RESPI is a technology platform dedicated to brokering, automated booking, charging and comprehensive management of sports courts and facilities.

By downloading, installing, registering or using any service of the Application, the user becomes a "User" (either as a Client or Administrator) and explicitly, voluntarily and unreservedly accepts all the clauses set out herein. If you do not agree with these Terms, you must refrain from using the platform and uninstall it.

2. ACCESS, REGISTRATION AND ACCOUNT SECURITY
To access the system operations (including viewing real-time court availability, creating bookings and posting reviews), the User must complete the registration process by creating a unique, non-transferable account. The User agrees to:
• Provide truthful, accurate and up-to-date information (name, surname and email).
• Keep their access credentials (password) confidential. Account use is presumed to be carried out by the account holder.
• Immediately notify RESPI support of any suspected security breach, unauthorized use or access by third parties.

RESPI reserves the right to suspend or cancel accounts that provide false data or repeatedly breach facility usage rules.

3. OPERATION OF THE BOOKING SYSTEM AND BACKEND AUTOMATIONS
RESPI operates through an automated backend engine that executes business logic in real time:
• Availability: Schedules and courts shown are subject to instant changes according to user demand and administration panel settings.
• Booking Process: A booking request is not considered formal nor confirmed until the backend receives successful payment confirmation from the external payment gateway.
• Membership Updates: The backend includes an automated loyalty algorithm that monitors booking frequency and volume. When thresholds are reached, the user's membership tier may be automatically upgraded, granting associated benefits.

4. PAYMENT POLICY, TRANSACTIONS AND SECURITY (STRIPE)
Payments and financial transactions within RESPI are processed externally via the secure Stripe gateway.
• When entering bank or card details, the information is encrypted under PCI-DSS standards and transmitted to Stripe servers.
• RESPI's backend never stores raw card numbers, expiry dates or CVV codes.
• The User authorizes Stripe to charge the total amount displayed on the confirmation screen before court allocation.

5. CRITICAL MAINTENANCE, CANCELLATIONS AND AUTOMATIC REFUNDS PROTOCOL
If an Administrator marks a court or zone as "Maintenance" (due to breakdowns, weather, structural repairs or force majeure), the following automated backend flow is activated:
• Immediate Cancellation: The system will identify and cancel all active bookings for the affected court and time range.
• Automatic Refund Order: The backend will send an instruction to Stripe's API to process a full (100%) refund to the original payment method. The refund timing depends on the user's bank.
• Emergency Notifications: The backend will simultaneously send an alert to the user's mobile device informing them of the incident and refund execution.
The user waives the right to claim additional compensation for damages arising from such maintenance cancellations.

6. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND PERMITTED USE
All intellectual and industrial property rights over the RESPI platform (including backend source code, databases, calculation algorithms, interface designs, logos, trademarks, texts and associated software) belong exclusively to their developers and legitimate owners. Reverse engineering, decompiling, mass data extraction (scraping), or using the RESPI API for purposes beyond normal app use is strictly prohibited.
legal.privacyText:
PRIVACY POLICY AND PERSONAL DATA PROCESSING OF THE RESPI PLATFORM

Last updated: June 2026

1. DATA CONTROLLER
In accordance with the GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679) and applicable national data protection laws, the User is informed that the personal data provided through this platform will be processed by the entity managing the RESPI backend and booking system. For queries or complaints about data processing, contact support@respi.com.

2. CATEGORIES OF PERSONAL DATA PROCESSED
To operate bookings, billing and interactions, the backend collects and processes:
• Identification and Registration Data: name, surname, email and password (stored hashed).
• System Activity Data: booking history, courts booked, payment statuses, usage statistics and reported incidents.
• Contribution Data: textual reviews, numeric ratings and administrator replies.
• Technical and Connectivity Data: device identifiers (push tokens), IP address, device model and OS.
RESPI never collects special categories of data (health, religion, sexual orientation, etc.) nor raw banking data, which are securely handled by Stripe.

3. LAWFUL BASIS AND PURPOSES
The legal basis for processing is the execution of the service contract accepted at registration. Data are processed for:
• User management: registration, authentication, session control and profile personalization.
• Booking and payment operations: sending payment requests to Stripe, managing schedules and automating membership upgrades.
• Maintenance security protocol: issuing refunds in case of forced cancellations.
• Critical push notifications: sending urgent messages about bookings, closed courts or transaction confirmations.
• Moderation and social features: publishing reviews and enabling administrator responses.

4. RECIPIENTS AND INTERNATIONAL TRANSFERS
RESPI will not sell or rent personal data. Data may be communicated to service providers necessary for platform functions, including:
• Stripe: for payment processing and refunds.
• Cloud and notification infrastructure providers: for secure hosting and push notification delivery.

5. RETENTION PERIODS
Personal data will be kept active while the user account is active. Upon account deletion, data will be blocked and retained only for legal obligations or judicial inquiries for statutory periods, after which data will be deleted or fully anonymized.

6. USER RIGHTS
Under GDPR, users can exercise rights free of charge: access, rectification, erasure, objection and restriction. To exercise these rights, edit profile fields in the Profile panel or email support@respi.com with the subject "Privacy Rights" from the registered address.
